steps.what: Supervise housekeeping personnel, inspect work and resolve immediate service problems

tasks.design: Keep live housekeeping supervision with the advisor. Existing assignments may be visible in {PROJECT}, but no new recording or automated performance judgement is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on observed conditions and communication with staff.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing job visibility can support instructions without replacing inspection or feedback.
tasks.still_hard: Privacy, resident preferences and judging whether cleaning is adequate in context.
tasks.human_edge: Giving clear corrective guidance while respecting staff and residents.
tasks.altitude: No change to supervision time or responsibility.

evidence.claim: The digest establishes no housekeeping-supervision automation saving; the proposed workflow is unchanged.

assumptions: Boundary is live supervision, not creating rotas or separately logging maintenance requests. Housekeeping labour is outside the advisor denominator and unchanged.
No machine step assumes a structured cleanliness or completion flag.
Native assignment visibility is sufficient; no custom build proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new supervision tool or procedure is introduced.
unknowns: Advisor's housekeeping authority and inspection responsibilities
research_questions: Which recurring service problems need clearer human handovers?

steps.what: Verify room availability, student eligibility and approved accommodation requirements
Match eligible students to available rooms using the published allocation rules
Resolve exceptional needs and approve the exact room assignments

tasks.design: Configure published eligibility and allocation rules in the housing system {OTHER}. The advisor verifies inputs, reviews proposed matches and resolves exceptions before approving the exact assignment set; external offers remain with authorised housing administration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual matching repeats eligibility and room-constraint checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Housing systems can restrict room options to approved eligibility and accommodation constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting needs, unsuitable stock and justified exceptions to ordinary matching.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining allocation limits and resolving sensitive individual circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Less matching effort where the advisor has allocation duties; no new allocation rights are granted.

reach.task: Issue room offers under the allocation procedure
reach.learn: Objective criteria, reasons and review routes

evidence.claim: StarRez supports rule-constrained room self-selection and rooms matching approved accommodations; this supports the matching capability, not local advisor authority.
Gonzaga reports235 staff hours saved per summer on room swaps in a vendor case; its inconsistent per-round baseline is not used for this scenario.
The proposed advisor matching savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is advisor-side verification, matching and approval where this role actually assigns rooms. In many European settings housing providers perform allocation; if the advisor lacks that duty, no advisor saving applies.

Advisor produces or verifies student ID, eligibility, room ID, availability, capacity, compatible constraints and policy revision in s1, retaining all35 hours including capture. Housing administrator supplies existing room inventory; accommodation officer supplies approved needs, with unchanged upstream review. Additional mapping work is counted below.
No accommodation diagnosis is inferred. Missing fields or disputed eligibility go to manual investigation within retained s2 and s3 time.
Test native configuration first. Matching is deterministic; sensitive exception judgement remains human. No student self-service transfer is required for the proposed saving.
unknowns: Actual allocation owner and delegated authority
Completeness of room and eligibility records
research_questions: Does rule-based matching reduce work after full input and exception review?

tasks.short: Lead and join residents' recreational activities

steps.what: Direct and participate in recreational activities for residents on or off campus

tasks.design: Keep activity leadership and participation with the advisor. The existing plan in {CALENDAR} supports delivery without replacing engagement or supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activities require personal involvement and response to residents' needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing schedules support attendance but do not remove activity work.
tasks.still_hard: Inclusion, changing conditions and residents who need individual support.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust and adapting the activity so residents can take part.
tasks.altitude: No change to activity contact time or responsibility.

evidence.claim: Live recreation leadership remains unchanged; early-years planning tools in the digest do not establish resident-activity delivery savings.

assumptions: Boundary is delivering and joining activities, not the separate programme-planning or calendar-coordination task. On-campus and off-campus activities are alternatives.
No automated action relies on a presumed structured risk or resident-interest profile.
Native schedule access is sufficient; no custom build.
Zero incremental upkeep because the activity process and tools remain unchanged.
unknowns: Resident support needs and local supervision requirements
research_questions: Which participation barriers require a human adaptation during activities?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep. No preparation baseline or reduced physical participation is invented.
